summary: SPK RC 55 sua loi 'no such table: scripts' sau khi nang cap va loi o vuong toi tren Chrome Windows.
changes: Sua loi 'no such table: scripts': truoc day goi SPK chi tao cau truc DB o lan cai dau tien, cac lan nang cap khong tao bang/cot moi. Gio moi lan khoi dong Coopeditor tu ap cac thay doi DB con thieu (bang Kich ban, cot ngay len song...), du lieu cu giu nguyen.
Giam loi o vuong toi tren Chrome Windows: khung chinh cua app co nen dac thay vi trong suot, hieu ung hover cua nut doi tu filter sang lop phu mau kieu Material 3.
